description: One race, or up to 5 at once with slugs, by Marathon Scout slug (from search_races): every stored date, the next edition's registration state and when it was checked, Boston-qualifier status, and links for registration, official results by year and live tracking (once confirmed). Links are stable marathonscout.com/go URLs that open the current official page; official_url fields name the destination.

slugs.description: Up to 5 slugs to compare races in one call, e.g. ["chicago-marathon", "berlin-marathon"]. Use instead of slug.
